<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Pranshu Joshi | Portfolio</title>
<meta name="description" content="Portfolio of Pranshu Joshi, B.Tech CSE (Hons.) Gen AI student at UIT, Karnavati University.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Pranshu Joshi | Portfolio">
<meta property="og:description" content="Generative AI, IoT and brand design projects by Pranshu Joshi.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700&family=Sora:wght@500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Person","name":"Pranshu Joshi","alumniOf":"UIT, Karnavati University","sameAs":["https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranshu-joshi-a557aa395","https://github.com/pranshujoshi-code"]}</script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#070A1A;--ink:#EEF1FF;--muted:#9AA3C7;--surf:rgba(255,255,255,.06);--bd:rgba(255,255,255,.13);--a:#22D3EE;--b:#7C5CFF;--c:#FF5CA8;--g1:rgba(124,92,255,.45);--g2:rgba(34,211,238,.28);--g3:rgba(255,92,168,.26);color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:light){:root:not([data-theme="dark"]){--bg:#F5F3FF;--ink:#17133A;--muted:#5B5886;--surf:rgba(255,255,255,.78);--bd:rgba(23,19,58,.12);--a:#0891B2;--b:#6D4AFF;--c:#D92D83;--g1:rgba(124,92,255,.26);--g2:rgba(34,211,238,.24);--g3:rgba(255,92,168,.2);color-scheme:light}}
:root[data-theme="light"]{--bg:#F5F3FF;--ink:#17133A;--muted:#5B5886;--surf:rgba(255,255,255,.78);--bd:rgba(23,19,58,.12);--a:#0891B2;--b:#6D4AFF;--c:#D92D83;--g1:rgba(124,92,255,.26);--g2:rgba(34,211,238,.24);--g3:rgba(255,92,168,.2);color-scheme:light}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(5rem + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.0625rem/1.7 "DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg);z-index:20}
.aurora{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(40rem 32rem at 12% 8%,var(--g1),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(36rem 30rem at 92% 22%,var(--g2),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(38rem 30rem at 55% 100%,var(--g3),transparent 70%)}
h1,h2,h3,.brand{font-family:Sora,"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.1}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--a);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:70rem;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--a),var(--b) 50%,var(--c));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

header{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + .6rem);z-index:10;margin:.6rem auto 0;max-width:68rem;width:calc(100% - 1.5rem);background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:999px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
header .in{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:.5rem 1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:.55rem .6rem .55rem 1.3rem}
.brand{font-weight:800;font-size:1.25rem;text-decoration:none}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.2rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;padding:.4rem .8rem;border-radius:999px;font-size:.95rem}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--surf)}
#tg{font:inherit;background:var(--surf);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:50%;width:2.3rem;height:2.3rem;cursor:pointer;margin-left:.2rem}

.hero{padding:5rem 0 4rem}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:999px;padding:.35rem 1rem;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted)}
.chip i{width:.6rem;height:.6rem;border-radius:50%;background:#34D399;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(52,211,153,.2)}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7.4vw,5.6rem);font-weight:800;margin-top:1.4rem}
.role{font:700 clamp(1.3rem,3vw,1.9rem)/1.3 Sora,sans-serif;margin-top:1rem;min-height:2.6rem}
.role span{color:var(--a)}
.role::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:3px;height:1.1em;background:var(--c);margin-left:4px;vertical-align:-.15em}
.lede{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.15rem;max-width:34rem;margin-top:.8rem}
.btns{display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2rem}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.85rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--bd);background:var(--surf);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn.main{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--b),var(--c));border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px var(--b)}

.me{background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:1.75rem;padding:1.6rem;text-align:center;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.ring{width:min(11rem,70%);aspect-ratio:1;margin:0 auto;border-radius:50%;padding:5px;background:conic-gradient(var(--a),var(--b),var(--c),var(--a))}
.ring div{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 3.2rem/1 Sora,sans-serif}
.ring img{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.me h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-top:1.2rem}
.me p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin-top:.3rem}
.me .tags{justify-content:center;margin-top:1rem}

@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(1rem)}}
.hero .chip{animation:rise .7s both}.hero h1{animation:rise .7s .1s both}.hero .role{animation:rise .7s .2s both}.hero .lede{animation:rise .7s .3s both}.hero .btns{animation:rise .7s .4s both}.hero .me{animation:rise .8s .3s both}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;margin-top:3.5rem}
.stat{background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:1.25rem;padding:1.2rem 1.4rem}
.stat b{display:block;font:800 2.4rem/1 Sora,sans-serif}
.stat span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}

section{padding:4.5rem 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.6vw,3.2rem);font-weight:800}
.sub{color:var(--muted);max-width:36rem;margin-top:.8rem}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.3fr;gap:2rem 4rem;align-items:start}
.about p+p{margin-top:1rem}
.about .txt{color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:1.5rem;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.45rem;list-style:none;padding:0}
.tags li{background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:999px;padding:.2rem .85rem;font-size:.9rem}

.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.skills .card{padding:1.4rem}
.skills h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:.9rem}

.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1.5rem;margin-top:2.5rem}
.proj{overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.proj:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--b);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -24px var(--b)}
.ban{height:9.5rem;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ban svg{width:4.2rem;height:4.2rem;fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.pb{padding:1.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.pb h3{font-size:1.45rem}
.pb .k{color:var(--a);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin-top:.2rem}
.pb p{margin-top:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.pb .res{color:var(--ink);padding-left:.9rem;border-left:3px solid var(--c)}
.pb .tags{margin-top:1rem}
.pb .go{margin-top:auto;padding-top:1.1rem;font-weight:700}
.pb .go a{color:var(--a)}

.tl{margin-top:2.5rem;border-left:2px solid var(--bd);padding-left:2rem;position:relative}
.tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-.6rem;top:.4rem;width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(var(--a),var(--c));box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--bg)}
.tl h3{font-size:1.4rem}.tl p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:.4rem;max-width:40rem}

.cta{padding:3.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--g3)),var(--surf)}
.cta h2{max-width:16ch;margin:0 auto}
.cta p{color:var(--muted);max-width:32rem;margin:1rem auto 0}
.cta .btns{justify-content:center}
footer{padding:2rem 0 2.5rem;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}

@media (max-width:860px){
.hero{padding:3rem 0}
.hero .wrap,.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.skills{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
section{padding:3.25rem 0}
}
@media (max-width:620px){.pg,.skills{grid-template-columns:1fr}header{border-radius:1.5rem}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="aurora" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<header>
  <div class="in">
    <a class="brand grad" href="#top">Pranshu Joshi</a>
    <nav aria-label="Main">
      <a href="#about">About</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#projects">Projects</a><a href="#education">Education</a><a href="#connect">Connect</a>
      <button id="tg" type="button" aria-label="Switch between light and dark theme">◐</button>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">

<section class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div>
      <div class="chip"><i></i>Open to internships and collaborations</div>
      <h1>Hi, I’m <span class="grad">Pranshu Joshi</span></h1>
      <p class="role">I’m a <span id="role">Generative AI student</span></p>
      <p class="lede">I build AI tools, connected devices and brand identities that help people find what they need.</p>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn main" href="#projects">View my projects</a>
        <a class="btn" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranshu-joshi-a557aa395" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">LinkedIn</a>
        <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/pranshujoshi-code" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <aside class="me" aria-label="Quick facts">
      <div class="ring"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Photo of Pranshu Joshi" width="380" height="380"></div>
      <h3>Pranshu Joshi</h3>
      <p>B.Tech CSE (Hons.) Gen AI<br>UIT, Karnavati University</p>
      <ul class="tags"><li>Gen AI</li><li>IoT</li><li>Design</li></ul>
    </aside>
  </div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="stats" style="grid-column:1/-1;width:100%">
      <div class="stat"><b class="grad">4</b><span>Projects built</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><b class="grad">3</b><span>Fields: AI, IoT and design</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><b class="grad">7</b><span>Sections in the LeadLocals brand guide</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="about">
  <div class="wrap about">
    <div><h2>About <span class="grad">me</span></h2><p class="sub">Ideas that people can open, use or hold.</p></div>
    <div class="txt">
      <p>I’m Pranshu Joshi, a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (Hons.) student specialising in Generative AI at UIT, Karnavati University.</p>
      <p>I turn ideas into working things: a website that matches people with government schemes, a phone-controlled home automation setup, and a brand guide for LeadLocals.</p>
      <p>Alongside the technical subjects, I’m building my communication skills through Personality Development and Communication (PDC), because a project is only useful if it can be explained clearly.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="skills">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>My <span class="grad">skills</span></h2>
    <div class="skills">
      <div class="card"><h3>AI</h3><ul class="tags"><li>Generative AI</li><li>Prompt writing</li><li>AI-assisted research</li><li>AI visuals</li></ul></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Web</h3><ul class="tags"><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>JavaScript</li><li>GitHub Pages</li></ul></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Electronics</h3><ul class="tags"><li>Arduino Uno</li><li>ESP32</li><li>Relay modules</li><li>Sensors</li></ul></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Design and speaking</h3><ul class="tags"><li>Brand guides</li><li>Presentations</li><li>Documentation</li><li>Public speaking</li></ul></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="projects">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Featured <span class="grad">projects</span></h2>
    <p class="sub">Four projects across AI, electronics and design, each with what came out of it.</p>
    <div class="pg">

      <article class="card proj">
        <div class="ban" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22D3EE,#7C5CFF)"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="21" cy="21" r="11"/><path d="M29 29l11 11M17 21l3 3 6-7"/></svg></div>
        <div class="pb">
          <h3>AI Govt Scheme Finder</h3><div class="k">Also titled YojanaMitra AI</div>
          <p>A website that helps people discover government schemes they may be eligible for, based on their profile.</p>
          <p class="res">Tested with different user profiles, checked eligibility accuracy and fixed incorrect recommendations.</p>
          <ul class="tags"><li>Website</li><li>AI</li><li>Testing</li><li>GitHub Pages</li></ul>
          <div class="go"><a href="https://pranshujoshi-code.github.io/ai-govt-scheme-finder/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open the live site</a></div>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="card proj">
        <div class="ban" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7C5CFF,#FF5CA8)"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="12" y="12" width="24" height="24" rx="4"/><rect x="19" y="19" width="10" height="10" rx="1"/><path d="M18 12V6M24 12V6M30 12V6M18 42v-6M24 42v-6M30 42v-6M12 18H6M12 24H6M12 30H6M42 18h-6M42 24h-6M42 30h-6"/></svg></div>
        <div class="pb">
          <h3>CADIO</h3><div class="k">App-controlled home automation</div>
          <p>Control a home from a phone app. An ESP32 drives a 4-channel relay that switches three bulbs and a fan, and an Arduino Uno works with an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor and a buzzer.</p>
          <p class="res">Documented with a wiring diagram, a build roadmap and key safety points.</p>
          <ul class="tags"><li>Arduino Uno</li><li>ESP32</li><li>Relay</li><li>HC-SR04</li></ul>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="card proj">
        <div class="ban" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF5CA8,#FFB02E)"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M24 43s-14-12-14-23a14 14 0 0128 0c0 11-14 23-14 23z"/><circle cx="24" cy="20" r="5"/></svg></div>
        <div class="pb">
          <h3>LeadLocals brand guide</h3><div class="k">Brand identity</div>
          <p>A complete brand guide for LeadLocals, whose tagline is “Local Growth. Real Leads.”</p>
          <p class="res">Covers seven areas: logo variations, brand story, colours, logo usage, typography, a UI example and brand elements.</p>
          <ul class="tags"><li>Branding</li><li>Typography</li><li>Colour</li><li>UI</li></ul>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="card proj">
        <div class="ban" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#34D399,#22D3EE)"><svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="6" y="9" width="36" height="30" rx="4"/><path d="M6 17h36M13 13h.01M18 13h.01M14 25h20M14 31h12"/></svg></div>
        <div class="pb">
          <h3>AI Portfolio and Presentation</h3><div class="k">Mini Project 2</div>
          <p>This portfolio. It brings my project details, visuals, results and documentation into one page.</p>
          <p class="res">Published online so every project can be shared with its outcome and conclusion.</p>
          <ul class="tags"><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>Responsive</li><li>Light and dark</li></ul>
        </div>
      </article>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="education">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2><span class="grad">Education</span></h2>
    <div class="tl">
      <h3>B.Tech CSE (Hons.), Generative AI</h3>
      <p>UIT, Karnavati University. Subjects include Fundamentals of AI (FAI) and Personality Development and Communication (PDC).</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="connect">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="card cta">
      <h2>Let’s build something <span class="grad">together</span></h2>
      <p>I’m open to collaborations, internships and conversations about AI projects. The quickest way to reach me is on LinkedIn.</p>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn main" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranshu-joshi-a557aa395" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Message me on LinkedIn</a>
        <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/pranshujoshi-code" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">See my code on GitHub</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

</main>

<footer>© 2026 Pranshu Joshi. B.Tech CSE (Hons.) Gen AI, UIT, Karnavati University.</footer>

<script>
(function(){
  var r=document.documentElement,b=document.getElementById("tg");
  try{var s=localStorage.getItem("theme");if(s){r.dataset.theme=s}}catch(e){}
  b.addEventListener("click",function(){
    var d=r.dataset.theme?r.dataset.theme==="dark":!matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme:light)").matches;
    var n=d?"light":"dark";r.dataset.theme=n;
    try{localStorage.setItem("theme",n)}catch(e){}
  });
  var rs=["Generative AI student","IoT project builder","brand and web designer"],t=document.getElementById("role"),i=0,j=0,del=false;
  if(matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)").matches){return}
  (function tick(){
    var w=rs[i];t.textContent=w.slice(0,j);
    if(!del&&j===w.length){del=true;return setTimeout(tick,1600)}
    if(del&&j===0){del=false;i=(i+1)%rs.length}
    j+=del?-1:1;setTimeout(tick,del?35:70);
  })();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
